title: Register a root store
summary: provideStore connects reducer functions to root state keys.

Explain the example for register a root store

blocks.text: provideStore connects reducer functions to root state keys. Angular can then inject a Store service into components.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

blocks.text: Create and export the reducer file first. The key reading becomes part of selector paths.
